entries.title: Public-record evidence workflow
entries.summary: # Public-record evidence workflow The public-record adapters attach a small evidence dossier to an existing source-observed property. Evidence remains separate from listing fields. A parcel record, an area statistic, and an equity scenario each carry their own scope and limitations.

entries.title: Node contract
entries.summary: ## Node contract ```js const { buildPublicRecordEvidence } = require('./server/public-records'); const evidence = await buildPublicRecordEvidence(listing, { allowNetwork: true, // Default false: reading a dossier never silently requests enrichment. acsYear: 2024, timeoutMs: 8000, });
